```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
```

# 1. Open dataset
```{r}
dataset_500_ENI_Lea <- read.csv(file="5. Models_par_clusters_pedoclimatiques/5.2. Models/Raw/dataset_500_ENI_Lea.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(-X) 
```


# 2. Scale & modif type of variables 
```{r}
predictors <- dataset_500_ENI_Lea %>% 
  mutate(id_parcelle=as_factor(id_parcelle),
         annee=as_factor(annee),
         type_production=as_factor(type_production),
         RegionAgricole=as_factor(RegionAgricole),
      region_biogeo=as_factor(region_biogeo),
      TypeCulture=as_factor(TypeCulture),
         clust=as_factor(clust),
         code_parcelle=as_factor(code_parcelle),
         exposition2=as_factor(exposition2)) %>% 
  relocate(code_parcelle) %>% 
  mutate(entomogame_1=scale(entomogame_1),
         FRic_flow=scale(FRic_flow),
         FRic=scale(FRic),
         FDiv_flow=scale(FDiv_flow),
         FDiv=scale(FDiv),
         FEve_flow=scale(FEve_flow),
         FEve=scale(FEve),
         Flow_dur=scale(Flow_dur),
         Flow_on=scale(Flow_on),
         nectar_present_1=scale(nectar_present_1), 
         zygomorphe_1=scale(zygomorphe_1), 
        JulianDay=scale(JulianDay),
         RisqueDebordement=scale(RisqueDebordement),
         coord_x=scale(coord_x),
         coord_y=scale(coord_y),
         Bordure_Largeur=scale(Bordure_Largeur),
         Bordure_BroyageFauchage_ramassage=scale(Bordure_BroyageFauchage_ramassage),
         Bordure_BroyageFauchage_SansRamassage=scale(Bordure_BroyageFauchage_SansRamassage),
         Bordure_NombreInterventionYEAR=scale(Bordure_NombreInterventionYEAR),
         IFT_Herbicide2013_2019=scale(IFT_Herbicide2013_2019),
          IFT_Biocontrole2013_2019=scale(IFT_Biocontrole2013_2019),
                                         DivRotation=scale(DivRotation),
SC_Year_Copper.compounds.1=scale(SC_Year_Copper.compounds.1),
          IFT_Hors_Herbicide2013_2019=scale(IFT_Hors_Herbicide2013_2019),
          CoefN=scale(CoefN),
          IFT_H=scale(IFT_H),
          IFT_T=scale(IFT_T),
          p_bio=scale(p_bio),
          forbs_100 =scale(forbs_100),
          perennial_100=scale(perennial_100),
        neophytes_100=scale(neophytes_100), 
        messicole_100=scale(messicole_100),
        nat_val_100=scale(nat_val_100),
        weeds_100=scale(weeds_100),
          rich_sp=scale(rich_sp),  
          shannon=scale(shannon), 
          nb_hill=scale(nb_hill))
```

# A. % forb species

## Vignes
```{r}
predictors_vignes <- predictors %>% 
  filter(TypeCulture=="Vigne") 
```


### 1. Temporalité et conditions parcellaires
```{r}
m0 <- lmer(forbs_100 ~ annee + JulianDay^2 + RisqueDebordement + coord_x + coord_y + exposition2+ (1| code_parcelle) + (1| RegionAgricole), data=predictors_vignes, REML=F,na.action="na.fail")
vif(m0)
dredge(m0) 
m0_best <- lmer(forbs_100 ~ annee + RisqueDebordement +(1| code_parcelle) + (1| RegionAgricole), data=predictors_vignes, REML=T, na.action="na.fail")
summary(m0_best)
Anova(m0_best)
r.squaredGLMM(m0_best)
```
Fixed effects:
                  Estimate Std. Error t value
(Intercept)        0.66222    0.08515   7.777
annee2014         -0.24560    0.09046  -2.715
annee2015         -0.24340    0.09709  -2.507
annee2016         -0.04792    0.09051  -0.529
annee2017         -0.11174    0.09084  -1.230
annee2018         -0.17954    0.09044  -1.985
RisqueDebordement  0.11593    0.05385   2.153

Response: forbs_100
                    Chisq Df Pr(>Chisq)  
annee             12.1521  5    0.03276 *
RisqueDebordement  4.6355  1    0.03132 *

           R2m       R2c
[1,] 0.0358581 0.4450856

### 2. Type de production
```{r}
mod_bio <- lmer(forbs_100 ~ annee + RisqueDebordement+ type_production +(1| code_parcelle) + (1| RegionAgricole), data=predictors_vignes, REML=T,na.action="na.fail")
dredge(mod_bio)
```
ns

### 3. Pratiques
#### 3.1. Pesticides échelle paysages
```{r}
mod_bord <- lmer(forbs_100 ~  annee + RisqueDebordement+IFT_H+ IFT_T+p_bio+ (1| code_parcelle) + (1| RegionAgricole), data=predictors_vignes, REML=F, na.action="na.fail")
dredge(mod_bord)
```
ns

#### 3.2. Pratiques de gestion de la bordure
```{r}
mod_bord <- lmer(forbs_100~ annee + RisqueDebordement+ Bordure_Largeur+Bordure_BroyageFauchage_ramassage+ Bordure_BroyageFauchage_SansRamassage+Bordure_NombreInterventionYEAR+ (1| code_parcelle) + (1| RegionAgricole), data=predictors_vignes, REML=F, na.action="na.fail")
dredge(mod_bord)
```
ns

#### 3.3. Pratiques intra-parcellaires
```{r}
mod_prat <- lmer(forbs_100 ~  annee + RisqueDebordement+IFT_Hors_Herbicide2013_2019 +IFT_Biocontrole2013_2019 +IFT_Herbicide2013_2019+IFT_Biocontrole2013_2019+CoefN+SC_Year_Copper.compounds.1+ (1| code_parcelle) + (1| RegionAgricole), data=predictors_vignes, REML=F, na.action="na.fail")
vif(mod_prat)
dredge(mod_prat)
```
ns
